events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The US has shown its military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is also being revealed. The conflict is affecting energy geopolitics and the containment of great powers.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is likely to lead to increased volatility in oil prices, making it a good opportunity to short oil-related ETFs. On the other hand, gold is often seen as a safe-haven asset during times of geopolitical uncertainty, making it a good buy.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or gold prices reach a resistance level
